title: About Tokenization 2050
description: About Tokenization 2050 — our mission, editorial team, and approach to covering tokenization and real-world assets.
body:
# About Tokenization 2050

Tokenization 2050 is an independent, global information provider dedicated exclusively to the tokenization of real-world assets (RWA).

We cover the entire spectrum of tokenized finance — from government bonds and money-market funds to stablecoins, real estate, private credit, and the technology infrastructure that underpins them — with the rigour and depth of institutional financial media.

## Our Mission

Tokenization is transforming how the world issues, trades, and settles financial assets. We exist to provide clear, accurate, and comprehensive coverage of this transformation for professionals, institutions, regulators, and informed observers worldwide.

## What We Cover

- **Markets**: Price movements, volumes, and trends across tokenized asset classes
- **Products**: Tokenized funds, bonds, stablecoins, and real estate instruments
- **Regulation**: Policy developments in the EU, US, UK, Asia, and Middle East
- **Infrastructure**: Blockchain platforms, settlement systems, and custody solutions
- **Companies & People**: Corporate strategy, executive appointments, and funding
- **Data**: Market statistics, league tables, and performance metrics

## Editorial Independence

Tokenization 2050 is not affiliated with any asset manager, exchange, blockchain platform, or token issuer. Our editorial decisions are independent. We do not accept payment for coverage, and we clearly separate news from analysis and opinion.
